label_margin_rule: eligible pair only if absolute within-subject target difference is at least the training-fold median nonzero absolute difference for that task; threshold computed on training subjects only
tie_rule: exclude exact ties and exclude below-margin near-ties
class_balance_rule: after margin filtering, deterministic downsample majority direction within each training fold to at most the minority direction count
validation_rule: apply training-derived margin threshold to validation subject pairs; no validation labels are used to choose threshold
